pretexts: hired as payment processor, financial officer, or administrative assistant
romantic partner needs help receiving payments from clients
romantic partner is investor, engineer, or military personnel

kill_chain_signals.contact: Victims approached after posting resume on website; victims meet someone online and begin relationship
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Offered position as payment processor or financial officer; told they won lottery; romantic partner claims to be investor or military
kill_chain_signals.payment: Asked to accept payments into personal account then transfer via virtual currencies, wire transfers, or email money transfers
kill_chain_signals.movement: Victims transfer funds to accounts in different countries or to 'financial office'
kill_chain_signals.cashout: Mules keep small percentage of money transferred; remaining funds sent to criminals

red_flags: Receive funds from unknown person or company and asked to forward it elsewhere
Messages about winning a prize or lottery that you never entered
Request to conduct unusual or questionable financial transactions on behalf of third party
Job duties include accepting payments from clients into personal account and transferring to different country
Romantic partner provides victim with cell phone and requests victim open bank account and send bank card
key_quote: Being used as a money mule victimizes you, victimizes others and can get you tied into a money laundering scheme and could result in facing criminal charges.
title: Money mule awareness
